summary: Iteration 5 shift-log feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 65/66 passed (1 skipped legacy), 1 real bug found: /api/messages/simulate-inbound does NOT invoke shift_log.log_message so message_in entries are never persisted from that endpoint. Frontend: full ShiftLogPanel flow verified as admin - Log tab, filter chips (all/emergency/voice/message_in/message_out/alert/position), Refresh, CSV download (correct headers), admin-only Clear button; live entry list updates after inject + refresh. Regression suite (backend_test.py, test_v12_features.py, test_channels.py, test_iteration4.py) still 100% green.

critical.issue: Bypasses shift_log.log_message hook. server.py::api_simulate_inbound calls message_store.record_inbound directly instead of on_dmr_sms, so no event_type=message_in entry is written to shift_log. Real inbound path via on_dmr_sms is fine; only the simulate endpoint is broken. Fix: after record_inbound, call `if shift_log: await shift_log.log_message(msg)` OR route through on_dmr_sms.

minor.issue: _shift_log_group_filter returns None when a non-admin has an EMPTY allowed_group_ids list, which then applies no group filter and effectively shows all entries. If the intent is 'no groups -> see only system-wide (group_id=None) entries', return [] instead of None so the $or clause restricts to group_id=None. Matches an existing pattern in /api/radios; either both should be consistent.

action_items: Fix /api/messages/simulate-inbound to write a shift_log message_in entry (call shift_log.log_message after record_inbound, or route through on_dmr_sms).
(Optional) Decide semantics of empty allowed_group_ids for non-admin on /api/shift-log.
critical_code_review_comments: shift_log.py::_log excludes _id after insert_one and broadcasts via WS - correct, no ObjectId leak.
shift_log.py::log_voice de-dupes by stream_id within 30s window - matches spec.
server.py::api_shift_log_csv sets Content-Type=text/csv + Content-Disposition attachment; filename validated in tests (matches spec header row exactly).
server.py::_broadcast intercepts type='alert' to log entries (line 186) - geofence alerts get logged even though geofence engine doesn't know about shift_log directly. Clean design.
ShiftLogPanel.jsx: CSV download uses fetch+blob URL and revokes it after click - correct, avoids memory leak.

success_rate.backend: 98.5% (65/66 executed, 1 legacy skip; the single failure is a real product bug in /api/messages/simulate-inbound)

seed_data_creation: test_iteration5_shift_log.py creates ephemeral TEST_ users (via /auth/register + admin approve + delete), transient radios in 66xx-69xx range, one TEST_fence_* geofence - all cleaned up in-test. Frontend test injected UI_TEST radio 6555001 which was cleaned up post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: One backend bug outstanding: /api/messages/simulate-inbound doesn't log to shift_log. Fix is a 2-line insert in server.py::api_simulate_inbound. Run `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration5_shift_log.py -n 0` after fix (pytest.ini defaults to -n 2 loadscope; the shift-log tests intentionally clear the log inside each test so they must run serially with `-n 0` to avoid inter-test races). Otherwise all 13 new tests + 52 regression tests pass. Iteration_4 regression still fully green.
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/server.py::api_simulate_inbound (line 776) the endpoint calls message_store.record_inbound directly and returns the msg. It does NOT invoke on_dmr_sms(), and it does NOT call shift_log.log_message(msg). The real ingest path (dmr_ingest -> on_dmr_sms -> shift_log.log_message) is correctly wired at line 306-307, but the developer helper endpoint diverges from it. Reproduction: POST /api/messages/simulate-inbound with valid body -> 200 OK, but GET /api/shift-log?event_type=message_in returns []. Mitigation: replace the return with `msg = await message_store.record_inbound(...); if shift_log: await shift_log.log_message(msg); return msg`, or better refactor to call on_dmr_sms so any future hooks stay consistent.
